dimensions.note: Pure data shaping over workflow artifacts; the report holds no credentials and makes no authenticated calls.
Structured placeholders via a never-throws tryLog wrapper; info on entry/finish, warn on skipped artifacts; no secrets logged.
Per-artifact narrow catches count skips; the outer catch implements the documented never-throws degrade contract with the degraded flag.
11 tests: pure helpers, collect (success, schema-mismatch skip, unreadable-artifact skip), execute happy path, and execute degraded path with a broken context.
Read-only and deterministic for the same artifacts; re-runs are safe.
No external HTTP calls; artifact shapes are validated with zod safeParse before use.
No connections, file handles, temp files, or cloud resources.
Placeholders only: RFC 5737 IPs, neutral account ids and service names. Environment-specific identifiers found in the first draft's tests were removed during this review.
